Date.CultureInfo=.*

# https/http/file urls
(?:\b(?:https?|ftp|file)://)[-A-Za-z0-9+&@#/*%?=~_|!:,.;\\]+[-A-Za-z0-9+&@#/*%=~_|]

# po file metadata
msgid ".*"|"(?:Project-Id-Version|MIME-Version|Content-Type|Content-Transfer-Encoding|Plural-Forms|X-Generator|Generated-By|Language):\s+.*"|"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To:\s+|^#.*

# unicode escaped characters (4)
\\u[0-9a-fA-F]{4}

# Windows Resources with accelerators
\b[A-Z]&[a-z]+\b(?!;)

# localization note (dtd)
<!-- Localization note .* -->

# localization key
^[-{}.\w]+=

# localization key
<!ENTITY\s+\S+(?:\s+(?=["'])|$)

# html/sgml/xml comment
<!--.*-->

# printf markers
(?<!\\)\\[nrt](?=[a-z]{2,})

# hex digits including css/html color classes
(?:[\\0][xX]|\\u\{?|[uU]\+|#x?|%23|&H)[0-9_a-fA-FgGrR]*?[a-fA-FgGrR]{2,}[0-9_a-fA-FgGrR]*(?:[uUlL]{0,3}|[iu]\d+)\b

# version suffix {word}v#
(?:(?<=[A-Z]{2})V|(?<=[a-z]{2}|[A-Z]{2})v)\d+(?:\b|(?=[a-zA-Z_]))

# IServiceProvider / isAThing
(?:(?:\b|_|(?<=[a-z]))I|(?:\b|_)(?:nsI|isA))(?=(?:[A-Z][a-z]{2,})+(?:[A-Z\d]|\b))
